featured_reviews.name: Sham Naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently took a handwriting class with Pooja mam, and I have to say, it was a great experience! From the start, they made the lessons enjoyable and easy to follow. Their approach to teaching handwriting is really practical, focusing on technique but also making sure we understand how to develop our own style.

The exercises provided were varied and kept things interesting. I appreciated how Pooja mam offered individual feedback, helping me improve my grip and posture without making me feel overwhelmed. I noticed a real difference in my handwriting after just a few weeks, which was encouraging.

What I liked most was the supportive atmosphere in the class. Whether you were a complete beginner or just looking to refine your skills, everyone felt comfortable asking questions and sharing tips.

Overall, I would definitely recommend Pooja mam,s handwriting class to anyone interested in improving their writing. It's a nice blend of learning and personal growth, and I came away feeling more confident in my handwriting skills!

featured_reviews.name: Bhalchandra Mistry
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered a 3D mural of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj from Infinity Art, and I must say the experience was absolutely amazing.

The final artwork exceeded my expectations in every way. The level of detailing, depth, and realism is truly breathtaking. Every element reflects not only artistic excellence but also deep respect for such a महान historical figure. The 3D effect is so lifelike that it feels as if Shivaji Maharaj is right in front of you.

The artist is incredibly talented , it genuinely feels like there is magic in their hands. The way they have brought life, emotion, and precision into the mural is simply outstanding.

The entire process, from ordering to delivery, was smooth and professional. I truly appreciate the dedication and effort put into this masterpiece.

I highly recommend Infinity Art to anyone looking for unique and high-quality artwork. Thank you for creating something so inspiring!

featured_reviews.name: Atoshi Rakshit
featured_reviews.review_text: My child has been going for more than 6 months and I can definitely see improvement in her colouring and drawing skills. She gives proper guidance and training to the kids.

featured_reviews.name: hunvil rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text: I am glad I enrolled my 7 year old son with Subhra for art classes. I was impressed when I learnt Subhra manages teaching students throughout the world. Being in California even though there is a time difference, Subhra was able to accommodate and provide a time slot that works best for my son. He started during summer, with an introductory class and during this time, she has been able to guide him and introduce him to the art techniques which have significantly improved his drawings. I would highly recommend Subhra for anyone looking to learn drawing/coloring.

featured_reviews.name: Lipi B
featured_reviews.review_text: Subhra  is very talented art teacher. Her teaching style is unique & she makes sure that students can easily understand the drawing techniques& enjoy art & craft. featured_reviews.name: JHARNA BHIWANDIWALA
featured_reviews.review_text: Awesome teacher she is..!!. Teaches all the techniques of drawing, painting from basics to advance. And the most important thing I love about Shubhra Ma'am is she gives personal attention to all her students. My seven year old daughter loves to go for her classes.

featured_reviews.name: Nina Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: My kids started Subhra's art classes about 2 months back during the lockdown. She is a very talented art teacher and engages with each kid on a personal level. Even though my kids have done a few art classes here and there the skills that they have picked up from her classes are visible in their art work and school work. She is hands on with each kid and works towards making them love the work that they do. My children love her class very much. Thank you Subhraji for sharing your talent.

featured_reviews.name: Yogita Pawar Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text: It’s good to see all rounder teachers around! Smit has enrolled for summer camp and enjoying all the activities thoroughly! Thank you Shubhra for engaging him at the best! Keep up the good work🤩

featured_reviews.review_text: Very nice experience with Subhra mam. Though it's online drawing classes, my 5 years little daughter is feeling very comfortable with her and doing good. She is enjoying classes with mam and learning a lot Thank you mam.

featured_reviews.review_text: Njoyed learning sculpture art from Shikha ma'am. She took lots of efforts to teach me. Right frm the scratch she taught me with lots of practice . Shikha ma'am is superb. Thank you Penkraft for teaching me.

featured_reviews.name: Ruchika Bhargava
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi, I'm really disappointed with the workshop held yesterday. The artwork wasn't completed, and we struggled to learn the leaf and flower techniques. As a professional, you should've considered the students' skill levels and planned accordingly. We paid in full, and the outcome was unsatisfactory. The faculty was good, but time was a major constraint. I appreciate the effort, but the experience wasn't worth the money and time. As a kind gesture we gave you our testimonies, but I hope you'll take our feedback seriously and improve.

Let us know how you plan to address the incompleteness of the artwork and the leaf and flower techniques. Will you be providing extra time or an additional class to complete the course material?

Also, the sitting arrangement, especially the chairs, was quite uncomfortable and improper. This added to our overall dissatisfaction with the workshop.

featured_reviews.name: Nobita
featured_reviews.review_text: Really frustrated with my experience at Penkraft. The calligraphy course sounded great on paper but the reality was very different — bad environment, inadequate infrastructure, and zero attention to basic comfort. It's hard to focus on learning when the setup itself is so poorly managed. Disappointing and a waste of time and money.

featured_reviews.name: Navtej Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently had a great experience at Penkraft Ideas Thane for art classes. Staff was very cordial and flexible. Especially trainer Shikha was found to be very talented and expressive in sharing tips and ideas about the type of art I was keen to learn. She taught me the nuances and intricacies of knife painting in simple ways. I would love to learn more and more from them.

featured_reviews.name: Ferin Susan Raj
featured_reviews.review_text: I have done my teachers training in three courses from Penkraft( cut-nib calligraphy, resin art and alcohol ink art).The trainings were recorded version but the content and the way it is delivered is good. I was trained under Master trainer Shabnam. Once the course was over, I had a live session with the trainer who helped me clarify doubts related to the course.
